description: Suggest AgentScout tools for a task described in plain words (e.g. 'scrape websites with an agent'), ranked by relevance with listed GitHub stars as a tiebreak. Optional pricing, open-source and runs_locally filters; use runs_locally when data must stay on the user's machine or servers (e.g. 'no-code automation that runs locally').

runs_locally.description: Where the tool can run, so data can stay on your side. 'offline' = runs fully on your own machine (e.g. with local models). 'self_hosted_or_offline' = also includes tools you can deploy on your own server. 'any' (default) = no filter. Based on what each listing says; tools without clear evidence are excluded from both filters.

task.description: What you want to get done.

name: best_for_task
title: Best tools for a task
